tools.name: get_project_state
tools.title: Inspect ProjectV2
tools.description: Read the committed V2 project in agent-sized slices: summary, site geometry, structure, landscape and climate, knowledge-bank sections (sources, measurements, terrain, geotechnical, planting with soil analysis, design rules, caveats), or one object by its stable ref.

prompt.role: You are a browser agent collaborating with a person inside the ProjectV2 spatial editor. Use stable semantic references, local model metres, straight-edged polygons and reversible ghost variants.
prompt.task: Read the committed V2 project in agent-sized slices: summary, site geometry, structure, landscape and climate, knowledge-bank sections (sources, measurements, terrain, geotechnical, planting with soil analysis, design rules, caveats), or one object by its stable ref.
prompt.input: `detail` (enum): `summary`, `site`, `structure`, `landscape`, `knowledge`, or `full`. With `knowledge`, pass `section` for one section or omit it for an overview. Pass `objectRef` to read a single building, storey, slab, wall, opening, space, roof, zone, plant, fixture, parcel or entrance instead.
prompt.tools: Use before proposing edits or requesting views. This is read-only. Prefer objectRef or a knowledge section over full; full is large. Treat conditional crop recommendations and unknown soil properties as constraints, not verified suitability.
prompt.output: Call this WebMCP tool with a JSON object. Read content[0].text as JSON containing status, projectRevision and summary plus tool-specific fields. Never treat visible report image object URLs as tool output.

detail.description: Slice to return. knowledge accepts a section; objectRef overrides detail.

section.description: Knowledge-bank section when detail is knowledge.

objectRef.description: Stable semantic reference such as building/main, storey/ground or wall/east.

tools.name: run_sunlight_analysis
tools.title: Analyse sun hours
tools.description: Compute direct sun hours for one landscape zone, plant, garden fixture, point or the whole site on a given date by casting rays toward the real NOAA sun against walls, roofs, tree canopies and fixtures. Works on the committed project or on an uncommitted ghost variant, so a proposal can be checked for the shade it adds before approval.

prompt.role: You are a browser agent collaborating with a person inside the ProjectV2 spatial editor. Use stable semantic references, local model metres, straight-edged polygons and reversible ghost variants.
prompt.task: Compute direct sun hours for one landscape zone, plant, garden fixture, point or the whole site on a given date by casting rays toward the real NOAA sun against walls, roofs, tree canopies and fixtures. Works on the committed project or on an uncommitted ghost variant, so a proposal can be checked for the shade it adds before approval.
prompt.input: Pass `targetRef` (a zone, plant or fixture ref, or `site`) or `point` `{x,z}`; `month` 1–12; optional `day` (default 21), `stepMinutes` 15–60, `hours` `{from,to}` local-time window, `includeGrid` for a coarse cell grid, and `variantRef`.
prompt.tools: Read-only. Call get_project_state first to resolve refs. To judge a proposal, call once without and once with its variantRef and compare. Report geometric hours and the cloud-adjusted expectedSunHours separately.
prompt.output: Call this WebMCP tool with a JSON object. Read content[0].text as JSON containing status, projectRevision and summary plus tool-specific fields. Never treat visible report image object URLs as tool output. Returns analysis with sunriseLocal, sunsetLocal, daylightHours, window, sunHours {mean,min,max}, firstSunLocal, lastSunLocal, shadedFraction, expectedSunHours, sampleCount and, on request, a grid of hours per cell (-1 outside the target).

targetRef.description: Landscape zone, plant or garden fixture ref, or `site` for the whole plot.

x.description: East-west local model coordinate in metres.

z.description: North-south local model coordinate in metres.

day.description: Day of month; 21 gives solstice and equinox dates.

stepMinutes.description: Sampling interval through the day in minutes.

hours.description: Optional local-time window, e.g. 13 to 18 for afternoon sun.

includeGrid.description: Return a coarse grid of sun hours per cell; -1 marks cells outside the target.

variantRef.description: Stable semantic reference such as building/main, storey/ground or wall/east.
